entries.73b5643f904a3427: It manufactures and sells coating and laminating related equipment used in producing secondary battery electrodes, composite packaging films and similar products; polymer processing machinery and vacuum deposition equipment, which are manufacturing equipment for plastic films, ceramic sheets and similar products; and various drying and heat treatment equipment, and also provides maintenance services and various construction work.

entries.7f8888fd1dfc1395: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥32,285 million, a decrease of 33.2% from the previous fiscal year. The main factor was that, as the EV market slowed in North America, its main market, major customers repeatedly reviewed their capital expenditure plans. By segment, coating machinery-related equipment was ¥25,348 million, chemical processing machinery-related equipment was ¥5,478 million, and others were ¥1,458 million; by region, North America was ¥15,897 million, Japan ¥8,853 million, East Asia ¥6,017 million, and so on.
entries.9f0ae4e6b4d2a6fc: The company's strengths rest on coating and laminating technology, drying technology, and running control technology, and it has a structure in which its experimental facility "Techunicam" enables processing-process demonstration tests and joint development with customers and research institutions. The company is focusing on developing new technologies centered on "high-cleanliness, ultra-thin film coating technology" and the "integration of wet coating and dry coating."
entries.ab8dd79cbd6abc80: Under the Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal years 2024–2027), the company gives top priority to "improving customer satisfaction," "expanding sales in the environmental and energy markets," and "strengthening cost competitiveness." In November 2025 the company published its revised Medium-Term Management Plan, shifting from a strategy centered on increasing production capacity, focused on coating equipment for secondary batteries driven by EV demand, to a strategy that makes use of its original strengths by focusing on developing thin-film new materials in various advanced fields, and states that it aims to build a business foundation for future growth strategies.

entries.c2722d9213ea5746: HIRANO TECSEED Co.,Ltd. is a company that manufactures and sells coating machinery-related equipment and chemical processing machinery-related equipment, with coating and laminating technology, drying technology and running control technology as its pillars.
entries.cf7671c3ed7c7790: Its customers are businesses that manufacture secondary batteries, magnetic tapes, composite packaging films, adhesive tapes, synthetic leather, plastic films, printed circuit boards, ceramic sheets and similar products. Nitto Denko Corporation is listed in the information on major customers.

entries.d6f0f393e48c2326: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,313 million, an increase of 45.0% from the previous fiscal year.
entries.d9b561255f8a5a91: Of net sales of ¥32,285 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, coating machinery-related equipment accounted for the large majority at ¥25,348 million, and by region North America was the largest at ¥15,897 million. In North America, the main market, net sales fell 33.2% year on year due to the slowdown in the EV market, while chemical processing machinery-related equipment, centered on film-forming equipment for electronic materials, rose 17.9% year on year to ¥5,478 million.
entries.e38edd28b265ffe5: This reportable segment manufactures and sells polymer processing machinery (manufacturing equipment for plastic films, film forming, electronic printed circuit boards, ceramic sheet molding, high-heat treatment machines and similar), vacuum film forming equipment and various drying and heat treatment equipment, and provides maintenance services and various construction work. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,478 million.

entries.e51480fec5daa918: The core of the strategy is to shift focus from a structure centered on coating equipment for secondary batteries to a broader range of applications in advanced fields such as thin-film new materials, in response to the slowdown in EV-related demand in North America, its main market. The company also states that it will strengthen sales activities in regions other than North America and in fields other than EV-related ones, and capture demand not only through new equipment installations but also through proposals for equipment modification and relocation and maintenance services for existing customers.
